slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's Turn 4 question was about capacity limits on warehouse-to-port routes, not about the number of containers a truck can carry. It never asked about truck capacity or any per-truck container limit, so the hidden truck-capacity fact (U6: each truck carries up to 2 containers) was never recovered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is unconstrained/irrelevant, so the per-truck limit of 2 containers was omitted from the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity in any turn, yet its final model contains no truck-related constraint and lists no per-truck limit, implicitly treating truck capacity as non-binding.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1) is P2 and does not affect the optimization problem's objective or feasibility, so stopping at READY_TO_MODEL after clarifying demand, distances, cost structure, route limits, and integrality was reasonable. No P0/P1 slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the core modeling facts (demand exactness, symmetric distances, single cost component, route capacities, integrality) and stopped appropriately, but never probed the hidden truck-capacity detail (U6), instead silently omitting any per-truck limit. Since that slot is only P2, the omission has minimal impact on model correctness.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
